newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain will be in first EMU wave -- Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain will be in first EMU wave -- Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Wednesday he was sure Spain would be in the first group of countries launching a single European currency.
"We are certain Spain is going to be where it should be, in the first wave of countries which constitute the European Monetary Union in the agreed timetable," Montoro said.
Montoro said the government would not ignore the criticisms in other countries about the appropriateness of Spain's participation in EMU from the outset.
"The government has to work to demonstrate that we are going to fulfil the convergence criteria...We are going to prove these criticisms are wrong," he said.
